finding_key: packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts::table-element repair fills in `cell.body` but leaves `cell.style`, `columnwidths` and non-object cells/rows unrepaired — the same stored-crash it claims to close
evidence: Verified against the supplied code: in docs-content.controller.ts the table branch of assertValidElementData repairs only cell.body and silently tolerates non-array rows (`Array.isArray(data.rows) ? data.rows : []`), rows without cells, and cells lacking style, and never checks data.columnWidths. In packages/slides/src/view/canvas/table-renderer.ts, drawTable reads `data.columnWidths.length`, computeTableLayout reads `row.cells[c]` and `cell.style.padding`, and paintCellFills reads `cell.style.fill` — all unconditionally and before the repaired `cell.body.blocks` is reached. Since the PR's own comments state writeSlidesRoot stores verbatim and migrateElement repairs shapes only, an authenticated PUT can persist a table shape that TypeErrors for every viewer, exactly the stored-crash class the PR claims to close.
